propositions: terraform plan fails on main because unescaped ${!PARAMS[@]} and ${PARAMS[$name]} in user_data.sh comments are parsed as HCL interpolations by templatefile(), not shell comments

templatefile() at main.tf:63 declares only data_volume_id as a template variable; three comment sites reference PARAMS (a bash associative array) which is not declared, causing Invalid character errors
the three broken interpolations are at user_data.sh lines 92:14, 92:30, and 111:46, all inside shell comments added by commit ef1a7e66a65d
terraform plan completes successfully when only those three comment sites are escaped or reworded to avoid unescaped ${...} sequences
a regression guard (check_templatefile_escapes.py) must scan templates consumed by templatefile() and reject interpolations whose root identifier is not in the declared variable map
applying the fix stops/starts aws_instance.gerrit (i-00880b2c7f13527c5) due to user_data change and creates/fails on three mcp-client-pat-* SSM parameters that exist in AWS but lack import blocks
